newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sees $15/barrel avg oil price in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sees $15/barrel avg oil price in 1997.

text.p: The Venezuelan government is basing its 1997 budget calculations on a revised average price of $15 per barrel for its oil exports next year, Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta said Tuesday.
The government had previously set an average forecast of $14.40 per barrel for 1997.
Arrieta told the Chamber of Deputies Finance Committee the $15 average price was still a conservative estimate.
Stronger-than-expected oil prices this year have seen the oil industry steadily revise its year average forecast up from $13.50 per barrel to $17.20 per barrel.
